classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read inside the separate _prefetch worker process which runs concurrently with the main loop's probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s) compute step, so the measuring rank never stops for a tiles read—it only waits on the queue for staged results, and other ranks are unaffected since this is a per-rank local worker.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: masks are read synchronously in the main measure() loop via probe.read_staged(...) before the compute sleep, so the issuing rank stalls (gated.append) until the read completes, while other ranks continue their own independent measure() loops.
